variables.camp_no: The camp's number as the admin set it on the camp (e.g. "162"). A camp without one sends no SMS (ADR 0046)
variables.date: Event date as DD-MM-YYYY. For specs templates, the first day of the collection window
variables.end_date: Specs only: last day of the collection window as DD-MM-YYYY; equals date for a one-day window
variables.venue: Camp, hospital or distribution venue name; 3 to 30 characters with no link, phone number or placeholder (ADR 0051). Use the camp, OT Schedule Day or Specs collection day venue_sms when set, else its full venue

dlt_portal_note: dlt_portal_body is the text registered on the DLT portal; each {#var#} is filled in the order listed in variables. dlt_body is the same text in MSG91 flow syntax. All six templates were approved on SmartPing on 23 September 2026. Check that each MSG91 flow shows Verified by DLT before enabling it on the VPS.
